query:
SELECT id, name, chemical_class, olfactory_profile 
FROM molecules 
WHERE name LIKE '%ène%' 
   OR name LIKE '%ol%' 
   OR name LIKE '%terpèn%'
   OR name LIKE '%terpén%'
   OR chemical_class LIKE '%terpèn%'
   OR chemical_class LIKE '%monoterp%'
   OR chemical_class LIKE '%sesquiterp%'
   OR chemical_class LIKE '%diterp%'
ORDER BY name
LIMIT 50
